name: Cypress Youth Action Committee (YAC)
org: City of Cypress Recreation and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at city events and go to monthly meetings and City Council meetings. You do research for the city plan. You also help tutor elementary students.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12, no older than 18. You must live in Cypress or go to high school in Cypress. You need a 2.5 GPA, not counting PE.
pay_detail: Volunteer. You must do at least 40 volunteer hours.
duration: September 2026 to May 2027, first Wednesday of each month
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 ran May 11 to July 16, 2026, or until 40 came in. They are closed now. Dates for next year are not posted.
how_to_apply: Get the form on the program page or at the Cypress Community Center. Turn it in at the center in person. Email and mail were not accepted last time. You also have an interview.
notes: These are last year's dates. Next year's dates are not posted yet. Space is limited. The center is at 5700 Orange Ave. Call (714) 229-6780.
